name: com.tencent.tcr.micro.updatesdk.TinkerResultService
description: After Tencent TCR's hot-update system applies a patch, this Service reports the result, cleans up the patch file after success, and restarts the app when the new code needs to be loaded.
disableEffect: The app can keep using its current features, but patch results will not be handled and a completed update may not be cleaned up or loaded.
